title: REQ · ExecutionPanel component and its tests are deleted
summary: ExecutionPanel.tsx and every test that imports it no longer exist
description: ExecutionPanel.tsx is imported by AdminApp.tsx, tests/stepper.test.tsx (an ExecutionPanel describe block), tests/actions.test.tsx and tests/executionReject.test.tsx. Deleting the component removes the Reject, Approve and Retry UI. Expected result: no file under game/frontend references ExecutionPanel.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/frontend/src/components, when listed, then ExecutionPanel.tsx is absent
Given game/frontend/tests, when searched for ExecutionPanel, then there are no matches
Given tests/stepper.test.tsx, when run, then the LifecycleStepper tests still pass
